title: Plain concrete footings.
officialText:
The thickness of plain concrete footings supporting walls of other than light-frame
construction shall not be less than 8 inches (203 mm) where placed on soil.
Exception: For plain concrete footings supporting Group R-3 occupancies, the thickness is permitted to be 6 inches (152
mm), provided that the footing does not extend beyond a distance greater than the thickness of the footing on either side
of the supported wall.
